title: Use of the VisuMax™ Femtosecond Laser
brief_summary: The objective of this clinical trial is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the Carl Zeiss Meditec VisuMax™ Femtosecond Laser lenticule removal procedure for the reduction or elimination of myopia from ≥ -1.00 D to ≤ -8.00 D with ≤ -0.50 D cylinder and MRSE (Manifest Refractive Spherical Equivalent) ≤ -8.25 D.
